=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:916-925 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The inline `gh_retry` wrapper is reported to shadow `n` and has a counter/update order that breaks the retry logic.
  WHY: One reviewer reports shell-scope corruption via `local n=0`, and another reports the loop condition is off-by-one and would defeat the retry contract; severity uses the highest reported severity and the reviewers disagree on the exact failure mode.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:916-925 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop is reported to stop after the first failure or otherwise never terminate correctly.
  WHY: One reviewer says the increment-before-check logic makes the wrapper attempt only once, while another traces the loop as retrying incorrectly; severity uses the highest reported severity and the reviewers disagree on the exact termination behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1032-1057 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_REF` is reported to behave inconsistently between the source repo and consumer repos.
  WHY: The reviewer says using `github.sha` only for the source repo and `stable` for consumers can leave consumer repos on older support scripts.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:996-1032 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `has_validate_label` is reported to retain stale state after a label-hydration failure.
  WHY: The reviewer says `continue` after hydration failure does not reset the variable, so later issues may inherit the previous issue’s label state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1035-1070 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `post-merge-force-poll` job is reported to duplicate the support-tree checkout and can silently skip the tick if checkout fails.
  WHY: The reviewer says this adds an extra large checkout on every run and makes the force-poll path depend on a successful checkout of the support tree.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Replace the validated silent-read paths with retried/safe reads plus explicit degraded-path warnings when retries are exhausted. A transient GitHub read failure must no longer look identical to a real 'nothing linked' result."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (post-merge-validate-dispatch and deterministic-skip-merge steps)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The current retry wrapper never actually retries (infinite-loop bug) and the fallback-helper-unavailable branch still exits with a clean "No linked issues found" message instead of the required degraded warning. The contract test asserts the strings but does not exercise the retry loop.
- requirement: "Add a conservative gate output that lets post-merge-validate-dispatch skip only when the gate can already prove there is no cached linked-issue data and no usable cached PR text to inspect. Do not skip cases that still require the existing PR-text fallback."
  expected_change_site: gate evaluate step + post-merge-validate-dispatch job + post-merge-force-poll job
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The new `post_merge_validate_context_definitely_empty` guard is present, but the independent `post-merge-force-poll` job was added in the last autofix run without the same guard, and the force-poll checkout duplicates the one already performed by the validate job.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
